title: Slideout
description: x-slideout plays a slide-out animation on its host for 0.5s each time the host is clicked, leaving towards direction; a second click replays it.

direction.description: The edge the host slides out towards.

setup: <button x-slideout direction="right">Click to slide out right</button>
